sources.provinces: FAO/GAUL/2025/level1 (cell mode; AJK and Gilgit-Baltistan are not GAUL Pakistan provinces and stay blank)
sources.elevation: MERIT/DEM/v1_0_3, mean to 1 km, then mean/max/min/std over 20 km
sources.slope: ee.Terrain.slope of MERIT DEM; mean and fraction steeper than 15 degrees
sources.land_cover: MODIS/061/MCD12Q1 2020 IGBP class fractions (cropland 12+14, barren 16, snow and ice 15, forest 1-5)
sources.population: JRC/GHSL/P2023A/GHS_POP 2020, mean people per km2 over the cell (negative no-data values masked)

method: Cell fractions from exact polygon intersection (shapely, EPSG:6933). Other bands via Earth Engine reduceResolution and computePixels on the same grid. No interpolation or filling.
